name: deskpet
description: Linux Electron desktop pet: cut out your own character, react to keyboard/mouse, play custom actions and voices, and chat with AI.
author: DeskPet Contributors

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --linux && node scripts/preserve-release.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux && node scripts/preserve-release.mjs
scripts.dist:linux:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage && node scripts/preserve-release.mjs
scripts.dist:linux:flatpak: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --dir && bash scripts/build-flatpak.sh
scripts.dist:linux:pacman: npm run build && electron-builder --linux pacman && node scripts/preserve-release.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build && electron-builder --publish always && node scripts/preserve-release.mjs
